summary: For decades, mitochondrial DNA disorders have stood among the most stubborn challenges in medicine: a group of inherited neurometabolic diseases affecting roughly one in 8,000 people, for which no treatment has ever targeted the underlying disease mechanism. title: EU Approves NEZGLYAL, First Drug Treatment for cALD
summary: The European Commission has granted marketing authorization for NEZGLYAL (leriglitazone), the first approved pharmacological treatment for cerebral adrenoleukodystrophy, a rare and rapidly progressing neurodegenerative disease. Neuraxpharm Group and Minoryx Therapeutics announced the decision, which covers male patients aged 2 to 12 years with Gadolinium-negative brain lesions. The authorization applies under exceptional circumstances and is valid across all 27 EU Member States as well as Norway

title: Gazyva FDA: 95% Remission at Week 52
summary:

The label covers patients aged 2 years and older with frequently relapsing or steroid-dependent childhood-onset disease who are already in remission. Genentech reported 95 percent sustained remission at week 52 with Gazyva versus 73 percent with mycophenolate mofetil.
